text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D4","page":1,"quote":"⌀60"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: AL HE30 # FINISH: SELF-ANODIZING # MACHINING: 3.2( 3.2) # WEIGHT(Kg ): 0.11 kg"}],"comment":"The outer diameter of the guide bush (D4, page 1, \"⌀60\") is a mating/functional feature but carries no fit or tolerance callout, and note N3 specifies an anodized finish that will add thickness to this surface. Without a defined fit or tolerance that accounts for the coating, the bush cannot be reliably assembled into its housing. The designer should add a fit or tolerance class to D4 and ensure it allows for the anodize build-up.","recommended_correction":"Add a fit or tolerance callout to dimension D4 that accounts for the anodizing thickness specified in N3."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D4","page":1,"quote":"⌀60"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: AL HE30 # FINISH: SELF-ANODIZING # MACHINING: 3.2( 3.2) # WEIGHT(Kg ): 0.11 kg"}],"comment":"Note N3 (page 1) calls out \"SELF-ANODIZING\" as the finish, yet the mating outer diameter D4 (page 1, \"⌀60\") has no tolerance or allowance for the plating/anodize thickness. Anodizing adds material to the outside diameter, which can cause interference or prevent assembly if not accounted for. The designer must specify pre-coating dimensions or tolerances that allow for the anodize layer on tight fits.","recommended_correction":"Specify pre-anodize dimensions or tolerances on D4 that explicitly allow for the anodizing thickness called out in N3."}]}
